description: EXPERIMENTAL local real-mode prototype (ANALYSIS_MODE=real): official YouTube Data API source plus real AI adapters. Selecting real mode never changes the compliance policy: real YouTube comments are analysed only if the CG-1 gate is satisfied independently. Discovery and assignment providers come from config/topic-providers.json. The topic pipeline is the validated one (docs/topic-validation-t1-t2-t3-sonnet-v3.md): discovery topic-discovery-v2 → consolidation topic-consolidation-v3 (same Anthropic model and settings as discovery) → Jev assignment, with the benchmark's discovery sample seed. Worst-case token figures size the per-call cost reservations; prices come from config/model-prices.json. No secrets here.
